title: LAVA: Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation Framework for Large-Scale Financial Document Auditing
abstract: arXiv:2608.16763v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Financial document validation in production, such as payroll auditing, tax compliance, and loan underwriting, demands exceptional accuracy, consistency, and reproducibility under strict enterprise constraints. In practice, documents arrive with heterogeneous layouts and formats, semantically rich and context-dependent content, and embedded business rules that current pipelines struggle to process reliably. We introduce LAVA (Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation), a modular, backbone-agnostic pipeline built on multimodal large language models, that integrates a four-stage design: document-rule retrieval, layout-preserving information extraction, auxiliary metadata enrichment, and auditable symbolic/arithmetic verification. LAVA supports robust rule grounding, fine-grained error attribution, and consistent, traceable end-to-end execution, capabilities essential for high-stakes deployment. translated_title: LAVA：面向大规模金融文档审计的逻辑感知验证与增强框架
translated_abstract: 在生产环境中的金融文档验证，如薪资审计、税务合规和贷款承销，要求在企业严格约束下具备卓越的准确性、一致性和可重复性。实践中，文档以异构布局和格式到达，包含语义丰富且上下文相关的内容，以及嵌入的业务规则，这些使得现有流水线难以可靠处理。我们引入了LAVA（逻辑感知验证与增强），一个模块化、骨干无关的流水线，基于多模态大语言模型构建，整合了四阶段设计：文档规则检索、布局保持的信息提取、辅助元数据丰富化，以及可审计的符号/算术验证。LAVA支持稳健的规则基础、细粒度错误归因，以及一致、可追溯的端到端执行，这些能力对高风险部署至关重要。在一个大型真实世界基准上评估，其性能显著优于现有方法。
tldr: LAVA通过多模态大语言模型和四阶段流水线，实现了金融文档审计中规则感知的稳健验证和可追溯执行，显著提升了大规模场景下的准确性与可靠性。
en_tdlr: LAVA, via a multimodal LLM-based four-stage pipeline, achieves rule-aware robust validation and traceable execution for financial document auditing, significantly improving accuracy and reliability at scale.
